822-1432-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-1432-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

512-2691-7014.easyPrerequisites: Ilysian Caryatid and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-2691-7014.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
512-2691-7014.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Ilysian Caryatid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

1445-1913-4871-6495.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-4871-6495.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
1445-1913-4871-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

5641-6258-6854.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2292-3305.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Body Launderer with haste.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, each Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing them to each connive.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the token Body Launderer.
When the Body Launderer token dies, its second ability triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

225-751-1671-3314.easyPrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to add {U}.
225-751-1671-3314.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2113-4629-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate The Incredible Hulk by tapping it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-4677-5411.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4677-5411.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1329-3518-6791.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2866-3967-4211-4986.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2438-3234-3293-5413.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2438-3234-3293-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat
2438-3234-3293-5413.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

862-5220-5683-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crimson Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2034-2267-5795-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
2034-2267-5795-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

1652-5626-6556.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-5626-6556.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

813-2072-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Scrollshift.
813-2072-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4824-6287-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 6 or greater.
4824-6287-6478.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Arbor Adherent.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Soliton.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2060-3169-4499-4929-6457.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Felothar.
When Felothar enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a token.
Resolve the Felothar trigger, causing you to sacrifice a nonland permanent and put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2060-3169-4499-4929-6457.notes: The combo does not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Felothar, Crystalline Crawler or Cryptic Trilobite.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2292-3090-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
2292-3090-5434-5555.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

101-1987-2239-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-1987-2239-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Ardent Elementalist and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-2239-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1887-2060-3525-3574.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mikaeus.
1887-2060-3525-3574.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
1887-2060-3525-3574.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

333-3967-5617.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-3967-5617.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1379-1849-3259-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
1379-1849-3259-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1379-1849-3259-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

428-1817-2736-5096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-1817-2736-5096.description:
Activate Zedruu the Greathearted by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Ghyrson Starn spell.
Resolve both Ghyrson Starn spells.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 8.

1322-2387-2457-2850-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Whenever the Insects enter the battlefield, Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each of them.
Activate the Ants by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

3363-4780.notablePrerequisites:
Tolarian Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
3363-4780.description:
Activate Tolarian Sentinel by paying {U}, discarding a card and tapping it, returning The One Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

876-1914-4022.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Hidden Herbalists.
Cowardice triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying {1}{G}.
Hidden Herbalists enters the battlefield, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1322-2103-3982-5131.notablePrerequisites:
If Living Lore is in your graveyard, you have not played a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
1322-2103-3982-5131.description:
Cast Living Lore from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
Living Lore enters the battlefield, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage with Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1261-3911.description:
Activate Galvanic Key by paying {1}, untapping Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
